cc:Work.dc:title: Atlantic SEUC contour core width
cc:Work.dc:description: 1978–1980 regional study; body reports ~120 km within the 20 cm/s isotach. Abstract separately reports ~100 km. No 100–120 km range, 110 km midpoint or error inferred. No fixed width-layer bounds, per-cruise values, annual extrema or geographic edges extracted. Source: Molinari, Voituriez & Duncan (1981), Oceanologica Acta 4(4), 451–456, p453. Independent OSW graphic; source PDF/figures not reproduced.
